appliesTo: any element except plain inline boxes
summary: Moves, scales or rotates an element visually without changing the layout.
details: The element keeps the space it had in the flow; only its painted result moves. Any transform other than none also makes the element the containing block for fixed and absolute descendants and creates a stacking context.

values.note: Shift back by half its own size (for centering).

gotcha: Because a transform creates a stacking context and a containing block, adding one to a parent can suddenly change where position: fixed children appear and which z-index wins.
